risk_note: RV2 by path. Commission estimate port for settlement rebate (D10-540) and the wallet fault (D10-565, D10-568): every commission_version an order points at now has amount and totals rows. refresh appends the current version in the caller's transaction (idempotent, no ledger, no balance); ESTIMATED / WAITING recompute with splitCommission on frozen terms and the snapshot's N (pdd less service_fee_fen); CREDITED copies the previous version unchanged (R9b) before any clawback. A created snapshot moves the order from version 0 to 1 under an optimistic lock, or writes the current version when already ahead. Residual, by ruling: a pdd order at ESTIMATED / WAITING whose service fee is missing writes no row (D10-568), so reading it at the new version still throws until the fee arrives (FU-PDD-NET-N). Not in scope: amount rows after R9 / R10 (FU-CREDITED-AMOUNT-ROWS), version rule (FU-COMMISSION-VERSION-RULE).
